column1: # Game profile of Risk of Rain Returns (Switch, update 1.0.5 v196608 / base 1.0.0 v0). Plays on the Mac from cutscenes, menus, audio and gameplay
# GameMaker Studio 2: a native runner (main, 26.0 MB text) whose game data is in the RomFS as game.win (FORM/GEN8) beside cutscenes, fonts and
# localization. It renders with OpenGL through EGL: main imports EGL functions and takes every GL call from eglGetProcAddress, which the host's
# GL layer answers on Metal (dm/gfx/gl/hle_gl.m, GL 3.2), so NVIDIA's GL driver (subsdk0) is never loaded. SDK 15.3.2
# The shaders are GLSL ES 1.00 that the runner writes at run time, in no game file: captured on the Mac (gl_capture.tsv lists all 84)
# and dm/gfx/tools/gl_shaders.py translates them offline; the host finds each by hash
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# no NVN shaders: the profile's NVN tables stay empty and the GL library comes from gl_shaders.py (gl_capture.tsv)
